title: 'Dear Bengal Poll Chief, How Many Voters Have ECI Staff Tried to Delete?' Asks Jawhar Sircar
shows: It reports the nine questions that Jawhar Sircar, a former Rajya Sabha member and former Secretary to the Government of India, put in a letter to West Bengal's Chief Electoral Officer, Neelam Meena. He asks how many applications election officers filed before the tribunals to delete names, under what authority and how many names were deleted, which notification introduced 'logical discrepancies' and how many electors they affected, whether ECINET can stop registration officers from seeing enumeration forms and the hearing dashboard, and whether every elector left off is covered by the special drive. The report sets the questions beside its own earlier figures on the appeals and the discrepancy flags.
quote: How many applications were filed by election officers before the tribunals for deletion of names; under what authority this was done and how many names were thus deleted
